name: scrawl
description: Sketch, compare and revise local wireframes with your own agent.

interface.shortDescription: Wireframe ideas together before writing code.
interface.longDescription: Bring your own agent to the Scrawl canvas you already have open. Explore variations, refine the canvas together and hand off the chosen direction. Changes autosave; a local file companion is optional.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Scrawl to sketch three distinct wireframe directions before building.
